meta.title: Signal Room
meta.globalStylePrompt: Naturalistic near-future drama, restrained contrast, practical fluorescent light, subtle handheld lens character.
meta.globalNegativePrompt: No glossy futuristic redesign, no holographic interfaces, no added text.

world.setting: A worn municipal communications facility during a night shift.
world.include: Functional analogue controls, scuffed painted metal, practical cable runs.
world.reject: Luxury technology, pristine surfaces, decorative science-fiction lighting.

qcChecklist: Mara's rectangular shoulder patch and short dark hair remain consistent.
Her left hand maintains clear contact with the red handset.
The wall console layout and amber indicator row do not drift between frames.
The handset label remains unreadable rather than becoming invented text.
Mara's spoken line begins only after she raises the handset to her mouth.

characters.name: Mara
characters.block: Adult operator with short dark hair and a compact, practical silhouette.
characters.visualDescription: Adult woman in a faded navy utility jacket with a rectangular blank shoulder patch; short dark hair; tired, alert expression; no jewellery.
characters.driftNotes: Keep the blank rectangular patch, jacket wear, hair length, and practical proportions consistent.

audio.voiceDesignPrompt: Low, steady adult voice; clipped professional cadence; quiet urgency; clean close-mic recording.
audio.voiceNotes: Record one clean master before adding room coloration in post.

continuityStates.name: Default
continuityStates.notes: Dry uniform at the beginning of the shift.

locations.name: Signal Room
locations.visualDescription: Narrow municipal control room with a fixed wall console on frame right, painted concrete walls, exposed cable trays, one overhead fluorescent fixture, and a metal desk facing the console.

continuityStates.name: Default
continuityStates.notes: Night-shift practical lighting with the amber console indicators active.

props.name: Red Handset
props.notes: The label area is blank and must not acquire readable text.
props.visualDescription: Heavy red corded handset with a coiled black cable, worn matte plastic, and a small blank recessed label plate.

continuityStates.name: On cradle
continuityStates.notes: Handset begins seated in the wall-console cradle.

continuityStates.name: Lifted
continuityStates.notes: Handset is in Mara's left hand with the cable hanging toward the console.

vehicles.name: Maintenance Cart
vehicles.notes: Parked in the rear service aisle; it must not move during the shot.
vehicles.visualDescription: Compact municipal electric maintenance cart with a blunt cab, narrow wheelbase, faded cream paint, black rubber bumpers, open rear tool bed, and no readable branding.

continuityStates.name: Parked
continuityStates.notes: Parked in the rear service aisle with the tool bed closed.

audio.name: Mara clean voice
audio.description: Canonical clean recording of Mara's restrained professional voice.
audio.notes: Apply room tone and handset filtering only after the clean master is approved.

scenes.title: Unexpected Signal
scenes.whatHappens: Mara notices an unexpected indicator, lifts the handset, and answers cautiously.
scenes.howItFeels: Routine work shifts into controlled unease.

audio.ambience: Low ventilation hum and distant relay clicks.
audio.notes: Keep ambience restrained under the dialogue.

shots.title: Mara answers
shots.desc: An amber indicator illuminates; Mara turns, lifts the red handset with her left hand, and answers.
shots.positioning: Medium three-quarter view from slightly below eye level. Mara occupies frame left at the desk; the wall console is frame right. Her left hand reaches across to the handset, and the coiled cable remains visibly connected to the console. A compact cream maintenance cart remains parked deep in the rear service aisle.
risks: Dialogue timing before handset reaches mouth
Maintenance cart silhouette and parked position drift
shots.safe: Hold a steadier medium shot as Mara lifts the handset without a camera move.

audio.note: Begin the line only when the handset reaches her mouth; retain the clean master and add handset filtering in post.
audio.sfx: One soft relay click when the indicator turns on; handset cradle release.
audio.sync: Handset reaches mouth before first word.

keyframes.label: A
keyframes.title: Indicator activates
keyframes.description: Mara sits frame left, looking toward the newly lit amber indicator on the frame-right wall console. The red handset is still in its cradle.
keyframes.notes: Preserve the narrow room layout and blank handset label.

keyframes.label: B
keyframes.title: Handset raised
keyframes.description: Mara holds the red handset to her mouth with her left hand; the coiled cable hangs back to the frame-right console; her gaze remains on the indicator row.
keyframes.notes: Maintain left-hand contact and the same console geometry.

clips.label: A
clips.title: Turn and answer
clips.motionPrompt: The amber indicator illuminates. Mara turns her head first, reaches with her left hand, lifts the handset in one controlled motion, settles it at her mouth, then speaks. Keep the console fixed and the camera nearly still with only subtle handheld movement.
clips.note: No extra gestures or console changes.
clips.audioNote: Speech starts after the handset reaches her mouth.
clips.sync: Handset reaches her mouth before speech begins.

performance.action: Mara turns her head first, reaches with her left hand, lifts the handset, settles it at her mouth, then speaks.
performance.objectInteraction: left hand lifts the handset and holds it at her mouth
performance.prohibitedMotion: no extra gestures or object morphing

camera.movement: nearly locked with subtle handheld movement

dialogue.startTime: after the handset reaches her mouth

sound.priorities: dialogue first; keep relay sounds restrained
